name: Live streams (SSE)
description: Server-Sent Events: the response never ends, events arrive live. Press **Send**, watch the **Events** tab fill up, then press **Stop** (the events received so far stay). These requests are kept out of the other collections so a collection run doesn't wait on an endless stream.

items.name: Wikipedia edits, live
items.description: Every edit on Wikimedia sites as it happens ([EventStreams](https://stream.wikimedia.org)). Busy: dozens of events per second.
